title: Burgmüller — 25 Études faciles, Op. 100 No. 2 (Arabesque)

reference.license: Public Domain (Mutopia 2013/01/12-203, Bas Wassink after Collection Litolff, 19th c.). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: 2/4, A minor (expectedFifths 0), LilyPond \tempo 4 = 152. 33 printed bars, matching the MIDI, which does not unfold the repeats.

performedBars 55 is derived from the Mutopia .ly at https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BurgmullerJFF/O100/25EF-02/25EF-02.ly (sha256 9ee203a6c2059700b10d45a7a1fd7a122803793af9a2e328d634bee538819a94), rendered with LilyPond 2.26.0 under \unfoldRepeats; folded, that render reproduces the pinned reference MIDI's onset+pitch stream exactly and counts 33 bars = printedBars. A hand-walk of the two \repeat volta 2 blocks with their \alternative endings gives the same number: 2 + (7+1) + (7+1) + (15+1) + (15+1) + 5 = 55, and the engraved bar numbers agree.
A \fermata on the final chord in both staves is one clock stop: expectedHolds 1.
Fast 16th-note right-hand runs at 152 — the fastest printed grid in the suite.
